notes.notes:
# Version 0.8.8a
- Date：2019/11/30

## Main Update
- Unlocked character: Remilia Scarlet

## Mechanic
- Added environmental buffs.
- Multiple actions in one round is now available.

## System
- Basic Nil-Soul reward of stage raises 95%
- Increase the amount of equipment rewards after battle win

## Character
- Reimu (Enemy).
  - Will prioritize Seal Fantasy and Omnidirectional Oni-Binding Circle in phase 3.

# Version 0.8.7
- Date：2019/11/20

## System
- The odds of item loot of White, Blue, and Yellow rarities were adjusted from [0.4, 0.45, 0.15] to [0.3, 0.45, 0.25], respectively.
- Some armors and accessories now provide speed boost.
- Story Replay is now available.
- Added achievements available on Steam.

## Character
- Reimu (Enemy)
  - Now casts Omnidirectional Oni-Binding Circle.
- Reimu (Allies)
  - New available skill, Omnidirectional Oni-Binding Circle.
- Marisa (Allies)
  - New available skill, Mad Collector.
- Daiyousei (Allies)
  - New available skill, Fairy of the Nature
- Hong Meiling (Allies)
  - New available skill, Rainbow Force.
- Koakuma (Allies)
  - New available skill, Devil's Game.

# Version 0.8.6
- Date：2019/11/5

## Character
- Rumia (Allies)
  - New available skill, Dark Sanctuary.
  - Great Eater: Altered as follows:
    - Old: Consumes 20 mana. Collect up to 2 loots within 2 grids. Each one collected gains 8%+ damage and 2+ range boost. Last for 5 rounds. Can stack up to 6 times.
    - Present: Consumes 15 mana. Collect up to 2 loots within 2 grids. Each one collected gains 12%+ damage and 2+ range boost. Last for 5 rounds. Can stack up to 4 times.
  - Dark Side of Moon: Mana cost decreased by 5, damage increased from 120% to 150%.
  - Moonlight Ray: Mana cost increased by 5,, damage increased from 180% to 210%.
- Daiyousei (Allies)
  - Poison (buff): Health point lost for each round decreased from 8% to 5%, and shield point lost from 4% to 3%.
  - Fairy Healing: Now heals 25% of the target's maximun health instead of 20%.
  - Daiyousei's Assist: Altered as follows:
    - Old: Release an aura within 5x5 range. Affected allies gain 50% life & shield absorption, and 25% damage boost. Lasts for 2 rounds.
    - Present: Release an aura within 5x5 range. Affected allies gain 35% life & shield absorption, and 20% damage boost. Lasts for 2 rounds.
- Hong Meiling (Allies)
 - Tiger's Cry (buff): Now gains Stun and Freeze immune.
 - Dragon Kick: Fix the incorrect damage.
- Hong Meiling (Allies/Enemy)
  - Star Reverse Blast: Each hit now deals 100% damage instead of 90%.

## UI
- Added new UI sound effects.
- Redesigned the icons for skills and status effects, so they're now more visualized.

# Version 0.8.5
- Date：2019/9/30

## Main contents
- New character: Izayoi Sakuya
   - Unlocking the 8th boss Izayoi Sakuya, she is a brutal assassin who can manipulate time

## System
- The life stealing (shield absorption, Reiki absorption) is related to all damage only. Before we fixed: Life stealing is based on damage to HP, and shield absorption is based on damage to shield.
- Some skills can work in two targets.
- Insert a Danmaku that cannot be erased.
- Time
  - Some skills can stop the buff time and not move the Danmku for player operation.
  - Some skills move the Danmaku with every player action.

## text
- “Miss” and “Dodge” were written in English.

# Version 0.8.4
- Date：2019/8/31

## Properties
- Critical chance: Critical is effect on all characters now.
- Attack range
  - Adjust origin number of character's attack range, no more growing numbers.
  - Attack range's extra damage and punishment effects alley and enemy. 
  - adjust the number of damage effected by attack range.
  - Attack range effects accracy, if character over the attack range will get punished by decrease accracy. (only player)
- Accracy: Add accracy systrem, player/enemy (97/100%)
- Dodge: Add dodge sysytem. 

## Text
- “Uptade history” add languages.

# Version 0.8.3
- Date：2019/8/12

## Major Content Update
- New Charactor: Patchouli
  - Unlocked the 7th stage boss fight! Patchouli is a senior spell caster, enormous knowlodge gives her power and abilities to face any situation in magical fights.
- UI
  - Added new icons for spellcards, most of Patchouli's spellcard icons has their own design. This makes spellcard's indentity much clear.
  - In town page, you can roll the page of character's skill states for reading skill.

## Fix
- Fixed a hang up issue during loading, caused by digit number style in some culture.

## Credits
- Thanks to CPT Gadget's help with localization work.

# Version 0.8.2
- Date：2019/7/12

## Major Content Update
- New Charactor: Little Devil
  - Unlocked the 6th stage boss fight! Little Devil is naughty, though low threaten, her fever of explotion may cause a big trouble.
- Text
  - Improve readabilty to battle related text.
  - English: all battle related text (stats, spellcards, battle status) has been re-worked.
- Battle Pace Acceleration 
  - Reduced waiting time on round start.
  - Speed up some characters animation.
  
## New Mechanics
- Danmaku Explosion: Danmaku now can trigger some effects, ex. explotion on hit.
- Life leach for other: Some unit can leach life and heal other units.

## Balance Change
- Rumia
  - Shadow Bolt: now dealing 200% damage (down from 250%).
- Daiyousei (Player)
  - Throw Kunai：now throw 2 (up from 1) each time.

## Spellcard
- Marisa
  - Master Spark: update with a new visual effect.

## Animation
- Hoan Meirin
  - Speed up jump move animation.
  
## Fix
- Fixed the "grey screen" issue caused by cultrue.
